161	def decisive(gaps: list[Gap], calculation: Calculation | None) -> list[Gap]:
162	    """
163	    For a no_bid on established evidence (positions whose complete ERP search found no matching material) only
164	    the gaps that can change it or the no_bid answer: the tender's Q&A (an amendment can bring a match back) and
165	    the discount approval. Masses, prices, keys and the other positions' materials only price a bid; retrying
166	    them held no_bid answers back by minutes.
167	    """
168	    result = getattr(calculation, "result", None)
169	    if getattr(result, "decision", None) != "no_bid" or not getattr(result, "missing_materials", None):
170	        return gaps
171	    return [g for g in gaps if g.area in ("tender", "doubt") or (g.area == "mail" and g.key == "approval")]

174	def better(new: Calculation, old: Calculation | None) -> bool:
175	    """The recalculation replaces the earlier answer unless it is less complete for the same decision (facts only
176	    accumulate, so that would mean a retry made things worse); a changed decision rests on new evidence."""
177	    if old is None or old.result is None:
178	        return new.result is not None or old is None
179	    if new.result is None:
180	        return False
181	    return new.decision != old.decision or new.completeness() >= old.completeness()

188	    def __init__(self, orchestrator):

204	    def feasible(self, gap: Gap) -> bool:
205	        o = self.o
206	        if gap.area == "doubt":
207	            return False  # verify() already sends doubtful mail facts back; a doubt alone is no reason to browse
208	        if gap.area == "tender":
209	            return bool(self._sites("tender")) and _module("research_tender") is not None
210	        if gap.area == "requirement":
211	            return bool(self._sites("specification"))
212	        if gap.area in ("erp", "material"):
213	            return getattr(o, "_erp", None) is not None
214	        if gap.area == "mail":
215	            if _module("research_mail") is None or not self._sites("mails"):

221	    def limit(self, gap: Gap) -> int:
222	        """Retries a gap gets: a mail kind whose first search finished and read records (its key may simply not
223	        exist for this tender) gets one, everything else GAP_TRIES."""
224	        if gap.area == "mail":

226	            if found is not None and found.records and not getattr(found, "stopped", False):
227	                return 2 if getattr(found, "kept", None) and not gap.reason.startswith(DOUBT) else 1
228	            if found is not None and getattr(found, "kept", None) and not found.records:

235	    async def run(self, first: Calculation, calculate) -> Calculation:
236	        """Fill gaps in rounds until none is left to retry or the time is up; returns the best calculation. A
237	        failure of the pass itself never costs the first answer."""
238	        self.best = first
239	        try:
240	            return await self._rounds(first, calculate)
241	        except Exception as error:
242	            self.o.board.problem("gaps", f"second pass failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")

245	    async def _rounds(self, first: Calculation, calculate) -> Calculation:
246	        best = first

255	            todo = [g for g in gaps if self.feasible(g) and self.tries.get(g.ident, 0) < self.limit(g)]
256	            if not any(not g.reason.startswith(DOUBT) for g in todo):
257	                break  # nothing the answer lacks; verifier doubts alone are no reason to browse
258	            if not todo:
259	                break

261	                self.trace("gap_no_time", seconds_left=round(self.left()), open=[g.ident for g in todo])

266	            if any(g.area == "mail" for g in todo):  # reads that finished before a cut still count

"""
The model behind the workers: the hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy by default.

AGENT_MODEL picks another model on the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint (QWEN_BASE_URL). Thinking is off for
navigation steps, which makes a step about three times faster, and on where a worker has to weigh evidence.

Timeouts are per mode, because the hosted model now and then hangs a call for minutes until the proxy drops it: a
thinking-off step answers in 2 to 5 s, so it gets a short timeout and a quick retry (LLM_TIMEOUT, 45 s, which
leaves room for the 30 to 36 s calls a longer answer takes); a thinking-on call legitimately takes 25 to 45 s, so it
gets a long one (LLM_TIMEOUT_THINKING, 90 s). Time grows with the answer: copying 80 table rows took 85 s even
without thinking. `settings(thinking)` carries the right timeout in the ModelSettings; pydantic-ai passes it to
the OpenAI client per request, so one client serves both modes. A call known to run longer (a reader writing a long
typed answer) passes `settings(thinking, timeout=seconds)`; that per-request value beats any timeout set on the
client. LLM_RETRIES attempts follow each failure with a short backoff (0.5 s doubling, capped at 8 s).

The timeout bounds the whole call, not each read: while the model works, the proxy sends the headers and then a
newline every few seconds, so a plain read timeout never fires and a hung call would run until the proxy gives up.

LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG=1 swaps the whole-call deadline for progress checks (see `_WatchdogModel`): each call is
streamed, a call whose first chunk does not arrive within LLM_FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT (20 s) is retried, and a call
that is answering may run on as long as it keeps making progress, up to LLM_MAX_CALL (300 s). The proxy streams
text and reasoning token by token but holds back tool-call arguments until they are complete, so a request with
tools may stay silent after its last token for as long as its timeout above; one without tools may pause
LLM_IDLE_TIMEOUT (15 s). LLM_HEDGE_AFTER sends a second copy of a call that has not started after that many
seconds and keeps whichever starts first (the losing copy may still be billed).

LLM_BACKEND=anthropic runs the same agents on a Claude model with the team's own key instead (LLM_MODEL, default
claude-haiku-5-5; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, a team secret in test and scored runs). Its calls go through the run's metering
proxy too: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, which the platform sets to $LLM_PROXY_URL/anthropic. Without a key the run falls back
to the hosted Qwen. Thinking off maps to Anthropic's thinking off (or the closest the model allows), thinking on to
adaptive thinking at LLM_EFFORT (default medium); see `anthropic_thinking`. The per-mode deadlines, the retries and
the call log are the same; the stream watchdog is Qwen-only (Claude calls do not hang the way the hosted model does).

LLM_BACKEND=openrouter runs them on an OpenRouter model with the team's own key (LLM_MODEL, default z-ai/glm-5.3-flash;
OPENROUTER_API_KEY), on the same OpenAI client path as Qwen: deadlines, watchdog and call log included. Calls go to
OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, else the run's proxy ($LLM_PROXY_URL/openrouter/v1), else (locally) OpenRouter itself.
LLM_PROVIDER pins the serving provider (default fireworks, no fallbacks; "any" lets OpenRouter choose). Thinking maps
to OpenRouter's `reasoning`: GLM 5.3 Flash cannot turn reasoning off (400 "Reasoning is mandatory"), so off is
{"effort": LLM_EFFORT_OFF (low), "exclude": true}, which measured 0 reasoning tokens on short answers; Qwen models
can, so off is {"enabled": false} there (see `openrouter_reasoning`); on is {"effort": LLM_EFFORT}.
"""
import asyncio
import contextvars
import dataclasses
import functools
import os
import sys
import time
from contextlib import AsyncExitStack

import httpx2
from openai import AsyncOpenAI
from pydantic_ai.agent.abstract import AbstractAgent
from pydantic_ai.exceptions import ModelAPIError, ModelHTTPError
from pydantic_ai.messages import ModelMessage, ModelResponse, ThinkingPart
from pydantic_ai.models import Model, ModelRequestParameters
from pydantic_ai.models.openai import OpenAIChatModel
from pydantic_ai.providers.openai import OpenAIProvider
from pydantic_ai.settings import ModelSettings

import localenv  # noqa: F401  (local runs only: loads agent/.env on import; the environment wins)

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
ANTHROPIC_MODEL = "claude-haiku-5-5"
OPENROUTER_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
OPENROUTER_PROVIDER = "fireworks"
OPENROUTER_RETRIES_BEFORE_FALLBACK = 2
USER_AGENT = "error404ai-rfq-agent"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 45.0  # thinking off: steps answer in seconds, so a hang shows early
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_THINKING = 90.0  # thinking on: a call reading a whole page may take 25 to 45 s
DEFAULT_RETRIES = 6
os.environ.setdefault("PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER", "1")


def env_seconds(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    """A positive number from the environment, or `default` when unset, empty or unusable."""
    try:
        value = float(os.environ.get(name, "") or default)
    except ValueError:
        return default
    return value if value > 0 else default


def timeout_seconds(thinking: bool = False) -> float:
    """Seconds one model call may take before it is given up and retried: LLM_TIMEOUT_THINKING for thinking-on
    calls (falling back to LLM_TIMEOUT when it is larger), LLM_TIMEOUT otherwise."""
    short = env_seconds("LLM_TIMEOUT", DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
    if not thinking:
        return short
    return max(short, env_seconds("LLM_TIMEOUT_THINKING", DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_THINKING))


def retries() -> int:
    """How many times a failed or timed-out call is retried (LLM_RETRIES, default 6; 0 turns retries off)."""
    try:
        value = int(os.environ.get("LLM_RETRIES", "") or DEFAULT_RETRIES)
    except ValueError:
        return DEFAULT_RETRIES
    return value if value >= 0 else DEFAULT_RETRIES


DEFAULT_FIRST_TOKEN = 20.0  # measured: the first chunk came within 9.4 s (p90 5.9 s) in 179 calls, either mode
DEFAULT_IDLE = 15.0  # text and reasoning tokens arrive at most ~1.5 s apart while the model answers
DEFAULT_MAX_CALL = 300.0  # a streamed answer is not cut by the proxy: one runaway reasoning ran 814 s


def watchdog() -> bool:
    """Whether calls are streamed and judged by progress (LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG=1) instead of a whole-call deadline."""
    return os.environ.get("LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG", "").strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")


def hedge_seconds() -> float:
    """After how many seconds without a first chunk a second copy of the call is sent (LLM_HEDGE_AFTER; 0 = never)."""
    try:
        value = float(os.environ.get("LLM_HEDGE_AFTER", "") or 0)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0
    return max(value, 0.0)

    """Seconds to wait before retry `attempt`: 0.5 s doubling, capped at 8 s (as the OpenAI client does)."""
    return min(0.5 * 2 ** (attempt - 1), 8.0)


# Who made each model call. Agent.run (patched below) sets LABEL to the agent function that called it: the nearest
# frame in this package outside llm.py and worker.py, or for run_worker the worker kind it set. pydantic-ai makes the
# request in tasks of its own, where the caller's frames are gone but the context variable carries over. USAGE sums
# each label's calls, so the run summary shows where calls, tokens and seconds went (the platform's call list has
# no caller).
LABEL: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("llm_label", default="")
USAGE: dict[str, list[float]] = {}  # label -> [calls, input, cached, output, seconds, thinking-on calls]
_PACKAGE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_NOT_CALLERS = ("llm.py", "worker.py")


def caller() -> str:
    """The agent function the current Agent.run serves (see LABEL)."""
    frame = sys._getframe(1)
    while frame is not None:
        path = frame.f_code.co_filename
        name = os.path.basename(path)
        if name == "worker.py" and LABEL.get():
            return LABEL.get()
        if path.endswith(".py") and os.path.dirname(path) == _PACKAGE and name not in _NOT_CALLERS:
            return f"{name[:-3]}.{frame.f_code.co_name}"
        frame = frame.f_back
    return LABEL.get() or "other"


def _labelled(run):
    @functools.wraps(run)
    async def labelled_run(self, *args, **kwargs):
        token = LABEL.set(caller())
        try:
            return await run(self, *args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            LABEL.reset(token)
    return labelled_run


if not getattr(AbstractAgent.run, "_labelled", False):
    AbstractAgent.run = _labelled(AbstractAgent.run)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    AbstractAgent.run._labelled = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def record(label: str, response: ModelResponse, seconds: float, thinking: bool) -> None:
    usage = response.usage
    row = USAGE.setdefault(label, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0])
    for i, value in enumerate((1, usage.input_tokens, usage.cache_read_tokens, usage.output_tokens, seconds,
                               int(thinking))):
        row[i] += value


def usage_table() -> str:
    """USAGE as lines, most input first, with each label's share of the simulated cost (Qwen's input, cached and
    output prices per token as the platform listed them; only the shares matter)."""
    def cost(row):
        return (row[1] - row[2]) * 0.15 + row[2] * 0.016 + row[3] * 0.47
    total = sum(cost(row) for row in USAGE.values()) or 1.0
    lines = ["calls  think  input  cached  output  seconds  cost%  caller"]
    for label, row in sorted(USAGE.items(), key=lambda item: -cost(item[1])):
        lines.append(f"{row[0]:5.0f} {row[5]:6.0f} {row[1]:6.0f} {row[2]:7.0f} {row[3]:7.0f} {row[4]:8.1f} "
                     f"{100 * cost(row) / total:5.1f}  {label}")
    if FALLBACKS:
        lines.append("hosted fallbacks: " + ", ".join(f"{label} {n}" for label, n in sorted(FALLBACKS.items())))
    return "\n".join(lines)


FALLBACKS: dict[str, int] = {}  # label -> OpenRouter calls that the hosted Qwen answered instead


def _transient(error: ModelAPIError) -> bool:
    """A failure worth another model: no HTTP status (timeout, connection, stall), a 5xx or a 429."""
    status = error.status_code if isinstance(error, ModelHTTPError) else None
    return status is None or status >= 500 or status == 429


class Stalled(Exception):
    """A streamed call stopped making progress (raised by the watchdog, then retried)."""


# The progress limits of the call being made in this task; set by _WatchdogModel, read by the stream wrapper.
_WATCH: contextvars.ContextVar["_Limits | None"] = contextvars.ContextVar("llm_watch", default=None)


class _Limits:
    def __init__(self, *, first: float, idle: float, silence: float, tools: bool) -> None:
        self.first, self.idle, self.silence, self.tools = first, idle, silence, tools

    @property
    def quiet(self) -> float:
        """How long the call may go without a token once it has started: a request with tools may be writing tool
        arguments, which the proxy only sends when they are complete."""

def _progress(chunk) -> bool:
    """Whether a stream chunk carries model output (text, reasoning or a tool call), not just a role or usage."""
    for choice in getattr(chunk, "choices", None) or ():
        delta = choice.delta
        if delta is None:
            continue
        extra = delta.model_extra or {}
        if delta.content or delta.tool_calls or extra.get("reasoning_content") or extra.get("reasoning"):

class _WatchedStream:
    """An OpenAI chunk stream that raises Stalled when the call goes quiet for longer than its limits allow.
    The proxy's keep-alive comments never reach here (the SSE decoder drops them), so they do not count."""

    def __init__(self, stream, limits: _Limits) -> None:
        self._stream, self._limits = stream, limits
        self._chunks = 0
        self._last = time.monotonic()

    def _wait(self) -> float:
        quiet = self._limits.first if not self._chunks else self._limits.quiet
        return max(self._last + quiet - time.monotonic(), 0.0)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        source = self._stream.__aiter__()
        while True:
            try:
                chunk = await asyncio.wait_for(anext(source), self._wait())
            except StopAsyncIteration:
                return
            except TimeoutError:
                if not self._chunks:
                    raise Stalled(f"no first chunk within {self._limits.first:g}s") from None
                raise Stalled(f"no progress for {self._limits.quiet:g}s after {self._chunks} chunks") from None
            if not self._chunks or _progress(chunk):
                self._last = time.monotonic()
            self._chunks += 1
            yield chunk

    async def __aenter__(self):
        await self._stream.__aenter__()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *exc) -> None:
        await self._stream.__aexit__(*exc)

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.close()

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self._stream, name)


class _WatchdogModel(OpenAIChatModel):
    """The OpenAI chat model; with LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG on, a request is streamed under progress limits, retried when
    it stalls, and handed back as one ModelResponse, so agents run unchanged."""

    async def _completions_create(self, messages, stream, model_settings, model_request_parameters):

    async def request(self, messages: list[ModelMessage], model_settings: ModelSettings | None,

            if 0 < hedge < limits.first:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=hedge)
                if not done:
                    print(f"[model] no first chunk after {hedge:g}s: sending a hedge copy", flush=True)
                    tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._open(messages, settings, params)))
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + limits.first
                    hedged = True
            while tasks:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0),
                                             return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
                if not done:
                    raise Stalled(f"no first chunk within {limits.first:g}s")
                for task in done:
                    tasks.remove(task)
                    if task.exception() is None:
                        inner, streamed = task.result()
                        stack.push_async_callback(inner.aclose)
                        if hedged:
                            print(f"[model] hedge: the {'first' if task is first_copy else 'hedge'} copy "
                                  "started first and is kept", flush=True)
                        return streamed
                    if not tasks:
                        raise task.exception()  # type: ignore[misc]
            raise AssertionError("unreachable")
        finally:
            for task in tasks:  # copies that lost the race or never started
                task.cancel()
            for result in await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True):
                if isinstance(result, tuple):
                    await result[0].aclose()


def _thinking(request: httpx2.Request) -> str:
    content = request.content or b""
    markers = (b'"enable_thinking": true', b'"enable_thinking":true',  # Qwen
               b'"type": "adaptive"', b'"type":"adaptive"')  # Anthropic
    if any(marker in content for marker in markers):
        return "on"
    openrouter = b'"reasoning": {"effort"' in content or b'"reasoning":{"effort"' in content
    excluded = b'"exclude": true' in content or b'"exclude":true' in content
    return "on" if openrouter and not excluded else "off"


async def _sent(request: httpx2.Request) -> None:
    """Note when a call left; a retry (the OpenAI client counts them in a header) is logged, with the timeout the
    attempt runs under, so a hanging model shows in the run logs before the worker times out."""
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()
    attempt = int(request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0") or 0)
    if attempt:
        print(f"[model] retry {attempt}/{retries()} thinking {_thinking(request)} "
              f"timeout {request.headers.get('x-stainless-read-timeout', '?')}s", flush=True)


class _TimedBody(httpx2.AsyncByteStream):
    """A response body that logs the call once it has fully arrived: the proxy sends the headers early and a
    thinking-on body can follow much later, so logging at the headers would hide the real duration."""

    def __init__(self, response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
        self._response = response
        self._stream = response.stream

    @property
    def elapsed(self):
        return getattr(self._stream, "elapsed", None)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        complete = False
        try:
            async for chunk in self._stream:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                complete = complete or b"data: [DONE]" in chunk  # a stream's reader may stop right there
                yield chunk
            complete = True
        finally:
            _log(self._response, complete)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.aclose()  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def _log(response: httpx2.Response, complete: bool) -> None:
    """One line per model call: status, seconds until the body was in (and until the headers came), request
    size, thinking mode, and which retry it was."""
    request = response.request
    now = time.monotonic()
    sent, headers = request.extensions.get("sent_at", now), request.extensions.get("headers_at", now)
    attempt = request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0")
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {now - sent:.1f}s (headers {headers - sent:.1f}s) "
          f"{len(request.content or b'')} bytes thinking {_thinking(request)}"
          + (f" retry {attempt}" if attempt not in ("", "0") else "") + ("" if complete else " incomplete"),
          flush=True)


async def _answered(response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
    """Called when the headers are in: remember when, and log the call once the body has been read."""
    response.request.extensions["headers_at"] = time.monotonic()
    response.stream = _TimedBody(response)


class _DeadlineClient(httpx2.AsyncClient):
    """An HTTP client whose read timeout is a deadline for the whole call (headers and body), so the proxy's
    keep-alive newlines cannot hold a call open past it. Expiry raises ReadTimeout, which the OpenAI client retries."""

    async def send(self, request: httpx2.Request, *, stream: bool = False, **kwargs) -> httpx2.Response:
        seconds = (request.extensions.get("timeout") or {}).get("read")
        if not seconds:
            return await super().send(request, stream=stream, **kwargs)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        try:
            response = await asyncio.wait_for(super().send(request, stream=True, **kwargs), seconds)
        except TimeoutError:
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        if stream:
            return response
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(response.aread(), max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.001))
        except TimeoutError:
            await response.aclose()
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no complete answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        except BaseException:
            await response.aclose()
            raise
        return response


_WARNED: set[str] = set()


def _warn_once(key: str, text: str) -> None:
    if key not in _WARNED:
        _WARNED.add(key)
        print(text, flush=True)


_KEYS = {"anthropic": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "openrouter": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"}
_ALIASES = {"claude": "anthropic"}


def backend() -> str:
    """Which model backend the run uses: "qwen" (the hosted model, the default), "anthropic" or "openrouter"
    (LLM_BACKEND, with the team's own key). Without its key a backend falls back to Qwen, so a missing secret costs
    speed, not the run."""
    value = os.environ.get("LLM_BACKEND", "").strip().lower()
    value = _ALIASES.get(value, value)
    if value in _KEYS:
        if os.environ.get(_KEYS[value], "").strip():
            return value
        _warn_once("no-key", f"[model] LLM_BACKEND={value} but {_KEYS[value]} is not set: using the hosted Qwen")
    elif value not in ("", "qwen", "hosted"):
        _warn_once("unknown", f"[model] unknown LLM_BACKEND {value!r}: using the hosted Qwen")
    return "qwen"


def model_name() -> str:
    """The model id: LLM_MODEL, else the backend's default (AGENT_MODEL still picks a Qwen-endpoint model)."""
    chosen = os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL", "").strip()
    if backend() == "anthropic":
        return chosen or ANTHROPIC_MODEL
    if backend() == "openrouter":
        return chosen or OPENROUTER_MODEL
    return chosen or os.environ.get("AGENT_MODEL", "").strip() or QWEN_MODEL


def openrouter_base_url() -> str:
    """Where OpenRouter calls go: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, else the run's proxy (the platform sets no OpenRouter variable,
    so it is built from LLM_PROXY_URL), else (only on a developer's machine) OpenRouter itself."""
    explicit = os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_BASE_URL", "").strip()
    if explicit:
        return explicit
    proxy = os.environ.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").strip()
    return proxy.rstrip("/") + "/openrouter/v1" if proxy else "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"


def openrouter_provider() -> dict | None:
    """OpenRouter's provider routing: LLM_PROVIDER (default fireworks; comma-separated for an order) without
    fallbacks to other providers; "any" leaves the choice to OpenRouter."""
    value = os.environ.get("LLM_PROVIDER", "").strip()
    if value.lower() == "any":
        return None
    order = [name.strip() for name in (value or OPENROUTER_PROVIDER).split(",") if name.strip()]
    return {"order": order, "allow_fallbacks": False}


# OpenRouter models whose reasoning can be switched off. Off on any other model (GLM 5.3 Flash: 400 "Reasoning is
# mandatory") keeps the lowest effort with the text excluded, which still bills the hidden reasoning tokens.
_REASONING_OPTIONAL = ("qwen/",)


def openrouter_reasoning(thinking: bool, name: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Our thinking on/off as OpenRouter's `reasoning` object for model `name` (default: the run's model). Off is
    {"enabled": false} where the model allows it (Qwen: measured 0 reasoning tokens, where low effort with exclude
    billed 2,000 to 4,000 hidden ones per call); elsewhere the lowest effort, its text left out of the answer."""
    if thinking:
        return {"effort": effort(True)}
    if (name or model_name()).lower().startswith(_REASONING_OPTIONAL):
        return {"enabled": False}
    return {"effort": effort(False), "exclude": True}


def settings_thinking(settings) -> bool:
    """Whether model settings ask for thinking, in the Qwen or the OpenRouter shape."""
    body = (settings or {}).get("extra_body") or {}
    if "reasoning" in body:
        reasoning = body["reasoning"]
        return reasoning.get("enabled", True) is not False and not reasoning.get("exclude")
    return bool((body.get("chat_template_kwargs") or {}).get("enable_thinking"))


def anthropic_base_url() -> str | None:
    """Where Anthropic calls go: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (the platform sets it to the run's proxy), else the run's proxy
    from LLM_PROXY_URL, else (only on a developer's machine) the SDK's default, the Anthropic API itself."""
    explicit = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "").strip()
    if explicit:
        return explicit
    proxy = os.environ.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").strip()
    return proxy.rstrip("/") + "/anthropic" if proxy else None


def model() -> Model:
    """The worker model. The client's own timeout is the thinking-off one; `settings()` overrides it per request,
    so a thinking-on agent gets its longer timeout without a client of its own. With LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG on, the
    Qwen model streams each call and judges it by progress instead (`_WatchdogModel`)."""
    http_client = _DeadlineClient(event_hooks={"request": [_sent], "response": [_answered]})
    if backend() == "anthropic":
        return _anthropic_model(http_client)
    if backend() != "openrouter":
        return _qwen_model(http_client, model_name())
    fallback = _qwen_model(http_client, QWEN_MODEL) if hosted_fallback() else None
    # With a fallback, a failing OpenRouter call gets fewer retries of its own: the hosted Qwen takes over sooner.
    attempts = min(retries(), OPENROUTER_RETRIES_BEFORE_FALLBACK) if fallback else retries()
    client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=openrouter_base_url(), api_key=os.environ["OPENROUTER_API_KEY"],
                         timeout=timeout_seconds(thinking=False), max_retries=attempts,
                         default_headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}, http_client=http_client)
    primary = _Watch

streamed, a call whose first chunk does not arrive within LLM_FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT (20 s) is retried, and a call
that is answering may run on as long as it keeps making progress, up to LLM_MAX_CALL (300 s). The proxy streams
text and reasoning token by token but holds back tool-call arguments until they are complete, so a request with
tools may stay silent after its last token for as long as its timeout above; one without tools may pause
LLM_IDLE_TIMEOUT (15 s). LLM_HEDGE_AFTER sends a second copy of a call that has not started after that many

    async def request(self, messages: list[ModelMessage], model_settings: ModelSettings | None,

            response = await self._request(messages, model_settings, model_request_parameters)
        except ModelAPIError as error:

                raise
            thinking = settings_thinking(model_settings)
            seconds = float((model_settings or {}).get("timeout") or timeout_seconds(thinking))
            print(f"[model] {self.model_name} failed ({str(error)[:160]}): this call goes to the hosted "
                  f"{self.fallback.model_name}", flush=True)

                       model_request_parameters: ModelRequestParameters) -> ModelResponse:

            return await super().request(messages, model_settings, model_request_parameters)
        settings = ModelSettings(**(model_settings or {}))
        thinking = settings_thinking(settings)
        silence = float(settings.get("timeout") or timeout_seconds(thinking))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        cap = env_seconds("LLM_MAX_CALL", DEFAULT_MAX_CALL)
        settings["timeout"] = cap  # the HTTP layer only guards the cap; progress is judged here
        tools = bool(model_request_parameters.function_tools or model_request_parameters.output_tools)
        limits = _Limits(first=env_seconds("LLM_FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT", DEFAULT_FIRST_TOKEN),
                         idle=env_seconds("LLM_IDLE_TIMEOUT", DEFAULT_IDLE), silence=silence, tools=tools)
        attempts = retries() + 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            token = _WATCH.set(limits)
            try:

                    return await self._attempt(messages, settings, model_request_parameters, limits)
            except (Stalled, TimeoutError, httpx2.TransportError) as error:
                reason = str(error) or f"no answer within {cap:g}s"
            except ModelAPIError as error:

                    raise
                reason = str(error)
            finally:
                _WATCH.reset(token)
            if attempt == attempts:
                raise ModelAPIError(self.model_name, f"model call failed {attempts} times; last: {reason}")
            print(f"[model] stalled thinking {'on' if thinking else 'off'}: {reason}; retry {attempt}/{attempts - 1}",
                  flush=True)
            await asyncio.sleep(_backoff(attempt))
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")

    async def _attempt(self, messages, settings, params, limits: _Limits) -> ModelResponse:
        """One streamed call (two when hedging): wait for the first chunk, then read the stream to its end."""
        async with AsyncExitStack() as stack:
            streamed = await self._start(stack, messages, settings, params, limits)
            async for _ in streamed:
                pass
            return streamed.get()

    async def _open(self, messages, settings, params):
        stack = AsyncExitStack()
        try:
            streamed = await stack.enter_async_context(self.request_stream(messages, settings, params))
        except BaseException:
            await stack.aclose()
            raise
        return stack, streamed

    async def _start(self, stack: AsyncExitStack, messages, settings, params, limits: _Limits):
        """Open the stream (request_stream returns once the first chunk is in). With LLM_HEDGE_AFTER, a second copy
        goes out when the first has not started by then; the first copy to start wins, the other is dropped."""
        hedge = hedge_seconds()
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(self._open(messages, settings, params))]
        first_copy = tasks[0]
        deadline = time.monotonic() + limits.first
        hedged = False
        try:
            if 0 < hedge < limits.first:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=hedge)
                if not done:
                    print(f"[model] no first chunk after {hedge:g}s: sending a hedge copy", flush=True)
                    tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._open(messages, settings, params)))
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + limits.first
                    hedged = True
            while tasks:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0),
                                             return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
                if not done:
                    raise Stalled(f"no first chunk within {limits.first:g}s")
                for task in done:
                    tasks.remove(task)
                    if task.exception() is None:
                        inner, streamed = task.result()
                        stack.push_async_callback(inner.aclose)
                        if hedged:

                                  "started first and is kept", flush=True)
                        return streamed
                    if not tasks:
                        raise task.exception()  # type: ignore[misc]
            raise AssertionError("unreachable")
        finally:
            for task in tasks:  # copies that lost the race or never started
                task.cancel()
            for result in await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True):
                if isinstance(result, tuple):
                    await result[0].aclose()


def _thinking(request: httpx2.Request) -> str:
    content = request.content or b""
    markers = (b'"enable_thinking": true', b'"enable_thinking":true',  # Qwen
               b'"type": "adaptive"', b'"type":"adaptive"')  # Anthropic
    if any(marker in content for marker in markers):
        return "on"
    openrouter = b'"reasoning": {"effort"' in content or b'"reasoning":{"effort"' in content
    excluded = b'"exclude": true' in content or b'"exclude":true' in content
    return "on" if openrouter and not excluded else "off"

    attempt runs under, so a hanging model shows in the run logs before the worker times out."""
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()
    attempt = int(request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0") or 0)
    if attempt:
        print(f"[model] retry {attempt}/{retries()} thinking {_thinking(request)} "
              f"timeout {request.headers.get('x-stainless-read-timeout', '?')}s", flush=True)


class _TimedBody(httpx2.AsyncByteStream):
    """A response body that logs the call once it has fully arrived: the proxy sends the headers early and a
    thinking-on body can follow much later, so logging at the headers would hide the real duration."""

    def __init__(self, response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
        self._response = response
        self._stream = response.stream

    @property
    def elapsed(self):
        return getattr(self._stream, "elapsed", None)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        complete = False
        try:
            async for chunk in self._stream:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                complete = complete or b"data: [DONE]" in chunk  # a stream's reader may stop right there
                yield chunk
            complete = True
        finally:
            _log(self._response, complete)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.aclose()  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def _log(response: httpx2.Response, complete: bool) -> None:
    """One line per model call: status, seconds until the body was in (and until the headers came), request
    size, thinking mode, and which retry it was."""
    request = response.request
    now = time.monotonic()
    sent, headers = request.extensions.get("sent_at", now), request.extensions.get("headers_at", now)
    attempt = request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0")
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {now - sent:.1f}s (headers {headers - sent:.1f}s) "
          f"{len(request.content or b'')} bytes thinking {_thinking(request)}"
          + (f" retry {attempt}" if attempt not in ("", "0") else "") + ("" if complete else " incomplete"),
          flush=True)


async def _answered(response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
    """Called when the headers are in: remember when, and log the call once the body has been read."""
    response.request.extensions["headers_at"] = time.monotonic()
    response.stream = _TimedBody(response)


class _DeadlineClient(httpx2.AsyncClient):
    """An HTTP client whose read timeout is a deadline for the whole call (headers and body), so the proxy's
    keep-alive newlines cannot hold a call open past it. Expiry raises ReadTimeout, which the OpenAI client retries."""

    async def send(self, request: httpx2.Request, *, stream: bool = False, **kwargs) -> httpx2.Response:
        seconds = (request.extensions.get("timeout") or {}).get("read")
        if not seconds:
            return await super().send(request, stream=stream, **kwargs)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        try:
            response = await asyncio.wait_for(super().send(request, stream=True, **kwargs), seconds)
        except TimeoutError:
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        if stream:
            return response
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(response.aread(), max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.001))
        except TimeoutError:
            await response.aclose()
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no complete answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        except BaseException:
            await response.aclose()
            raise
        return response

            if 0 < hedge < limits.first:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=hedge)
                if not done:
                    print(f"[model] no first chunk after {hedge:g}s: sending a hedge copy", flush=True)
                    tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._open(messages, settings, params)))
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + limits.first
                    hedged = True
            while tasks:
                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0),
                                             return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
                if not done:
                    raise Stalled(f"no first chunk within {limits.first:g}s")
                for task in done:
                    tasks.remove(task)
                    if task.exception() is None:
                        inner, streamed = task.result()
                        stack.push_async_callback(inner.aclose)
                        if hedged:
                            print(f"[model] hedge: the {'first' if task is first_copy else 'hedge'} copy "
                                  "started first and is kept", flush=True)
                        return streamed
                    if not tasks:
                        raise task.exception()  # type: ignore[misc]
            raise AssertionError("unreachable")
        finally:
            for task in tasks:  # copies that lost the race or never started
                task.cancel()
            for result in await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True):

def _thinking(request: httpx2.Request) -> str:
    content = request.content or b""
    markers = (b'"enable_thinking": true', b'"enable_thinking":true',  # Qwen
               b'"type": "adaptive"', b'"type":"adaptive"')  # Anthropic
    if any(marker in content for marker in markers):
        return "on"
    openrouter = b'"reasoning": {"effort"' in content or b'"reasoning":{"effort"' in content
    excluded = b'"exclude": true' in content or b'"exclude":true' in content
    return "on" if openrouter and not excluded else "off"


async def _sent(request: httpx2.Request) -> None:
    """Note when a call left; a retry (the OpenAI client counts them in a header) is logged, with the timeout the
    attempt runs under, so a hanging model shows in the run logs before the worker times out."""
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()
    attempt = int(request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0") or 0)
    if attempt:
        print(f"[model] retry {attempt}/{retries()} thinking {_thinking(request)} "
              f"timeout {request.headers.get('x-stainless-read-timeout', '?')}s", flush=True)


class _TimedBody(httpx2.AsyncByteStream):
    """A response body that logs the call once it has fully arrived: the proxy sends the headers early and a
    thinking-on body can follow much later, so logging at the headers would hide the real duration."""

    def __init__(self, response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
        self._response = response
        self._stream = response.stream

    @property
    def elapsed(self):
        return getattr(self._stream, "elapsed", None)

    async def __aiter__(self):
        complete = False
        try:
            async for chunk in self._stream:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                complete = complete or b"data: [DONE]" in chunk  # a stream's reader may stop right there
                yield chunk
            complete = True
        finally:
            _log(self._response, complete)

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._stream.aclose()  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def _log(response: httpx2.Response, complete: bool) -> None:
    """One line per model call: status, seconds until the body was in (and until the headers came), request
    size, thinking mode, and which retry it was."""
    request = response.request
    now = time.monotonic()
    sent, headers = request.extensions.get("sent_at", now), request.extensions.get("headers_at", now)
    attempt = request.headers.get("x-stainless-retry-count", "0")
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {now - sent:.1f}s (headers {headers - sent:.1f}s) "
          f"{len(request.content or b'')} bytes thinking {_thinking(request)}"
          + (f" retry {attempt}" if attempt not in ("", "0") else "") + ("" if complete else " incomplete"),
          flush=True)


async def _answered(response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
    """Called when the headers are in: remember when, and log the call once the body has been read."""
    response.request.extensions["headers_at"] = time.monotonic()
    response.stream = _TimedBody(response)


class _DeadlineClient(httpx2.AsyncClient):
    """An HTTP client whose read timeout is a deadline for the whole call (headers and body), so the proxy's
    keep-alive newlines cannot hold a call open past it. Expiry raises ReadTimeout, which the OpenAI client retries."""

    async def send(self, request: httpx2.Request, *, stream: bool = False, **kwargs) -> httpx2.Response:
        seconds = (request.extensions.get("timeout") or {}).get("read")
        if not seconds:
            return await super().send(request, stream=stream, **kwargs)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        try:
            response = await asyncio.wait_for(super().send(request, stream=True, **kwargs), seconds)
        except TimeoutError:
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        if stream:
            return response
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(response.aread(), max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.001))
        except TimeoutError:
            await response.aclose()
            raise httpx2.ReadTimeout(f"no complete answer within {seconds:g}s", request=request) from None
        except BaseException:
            await response.aclose()
            raise
        return response


_WARNED: set[str] = set()


def _warn_once(key: str, text: str) -> None:
    if key not in _WARNED:
        _WARNED.add(key)
        print(text, flush=True)

    proxy = os.environ.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").strip()
    return proxy.rstrip("/") + "/anthropic" if proxy else None


def model() -> Model:
    """The worker model. The client's own timeout is the thinking-off one; `settings()` overrides it per request,
    so a thinking-on agent gets its longer timeout without a client of its own. With LLM_STREAM_WATCHDOG on, the
    Qwen model streams each call and judges it by progress instead (`_WatchdogModel`)."""
    http_client = _DeadlineClient(event_hooks={"request": [_sent], "response": [_answered]})
    if backend() == "anthropic":
        return _anthropic_model(http_client)
    if backend() != "openrouter":
        return _qwen_model(http_client, model_name())
    fallback = _qwen_model(http_client, QWEN_MODEL) if hosted_fallback() else None
    # With a fallback, a failing OpenRouter call gets fewer retries of its own: the hosted Qwen takes over sooner.
    attempts = min(retries(), OPENROUTER_RETRIES_BEFORE_FALLBACK) if fallback else retries()
    client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=openrouter_base_url(), api_key=os.environ["OPENROUTER_API_KEY"],
                         timeout=timeout_seconds(thinking=False), max_retries=attempts,
                         default_headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}, http_client=http_client)
    primary = _WatchdogModel(model_name(), provider=OpenAIProvider(openai_client=client))
    primary.fallback = fallback
    return primary


def _qwen_model(http_client: httpx2.AsyncClient, name: str) -> "_WatchdogModel":
    client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                         timeout=timeout_seconds(thinking=False), max_retries=retries(), http_client=http_client)
    return _WatchdogModel(name, provider=OpenAIProvider(openai_client=client))


def hosted_fallback() -> bool:
    """Whether an OpenRouter call that fails for good (5xx, 429, timeout or stall after its retries) is made once
    more on the hosted Qwen: on unless LLM_HOSTED_FALLBACK=0, and only when the hosted endpoint is configured."""
    if os.environ.get("LLM_HOSTED_FALLBACK", "").strip().lower() in ("0", "false", "no", "off"):
        return False
    return bool(os.environ.get("QWEN_BASE_URL", "").strip() and os.environ.get("QWEN_API_KEY", "").strip())

"""
The agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

v2: read the brief, then the orchestrator (planner, findings board, research workers, verifier, calc) builds the
answer, and submit.py enters and signs the bid with it; without an answer every position is omitted, as in v1.
AGENT_RESEARCH=0 skips the research (the v1 path). See docs/plan.md.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import localenv  # noqa: F401  (first: local runs read agent/.env before any module reads its settings)
import browser_tools
import browsers
import llm
import loopwatch
import run as contract
from briefing import read_brief
from browser_tools import SiteSession
from orchestrator import Orchestrator
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from submit import BidFlow, Mailbox, submit_bid
import tracing
from tracing import Trace

SAFETY_SECONDS = 90  # the answer must be in before the run expires
LOCAL_SECONDS = 20 * 60  # the scouting run does not expire; behave like a scored run
RESEARCH_START_SECONDS = 600  # a website that only research needs is warmed this long, then given up


def warm_up(sessions: dict[str, SiteSession], deadline: float, critical: set[str]) -> dict[str, asyncio.Task]:
    """
    Start signing in to every website in the background and return at once: nothing waits for all of them. The
    `critical` ones (the bid website, the mailbox) keep retrying until START_MARGIN before the deadline; the others
    give up after RESEARCH_START_SECONDS. A session whose start is still running can be handed out: its first look
    waits for the start (SiteSession.revive).
    """
    browser_tools.DEADLINE = deadline
    tasks = {}
    for name, session in sessions.items():
        limit = deadline - browser_tools.START_MARGIN
        if name not in critical:
            limit = min(limit, time.monotonic() + RESEARCH_START_SECONDS)
        session.until = limit
        tasks[name] = asyncio.create_task(session.start(until=limit), name=f"start@{name}")
        tasks[name].add_done_callback(lambda t: t.cancelled() or t.exception())  # failures are traced in start
    return tasks


async def solve(task: dict, page, answer: dict | None = None,
                attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """
    Enter the bid on the run's website (a "site" submission) and return None.

    `answer` (calc's BidResult.answer()) and `attributes` (per position, the chosen material's attributes) are what
    the bid worker enters; positions they do not give completely are omitted. Unless given, the orchestrator
    researches them; a research failure never costs the signed bid.
    """
    trace = Trace()
    loopwatch.Watchdog(activity=lambda: trace.last).start()  # a blocked loop or a silent run dumps its stacks
    left = min(contract.seconds_left(task), LOCAL_SECONDS)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + left - SAFETY_SECONDS
    # Sign in to every website in the background: the brief, the planner and the workers never wait for all of
    # them. The bid website (named by the run contract) keeps warming; the mailbox too, once the brief names it.
    contexts = await browsers.more_contexts(page, len(task["access"]))
    sessions = {site["siteId"]: SiteSession(site, context, trace) for site, context in zip(task["access"], contexts)}
    contract_site = (task.get("submission") or {}).get("siteId")
    starts = warm_up(sessions, deadline, {contract_site} if contract_site in sessions else set(sessions))
    briefing = await read_brief(task)
    # The run contract names the submission website; it wins over the model's reading of the brief.
    if contract_site in sessions and contract_site != briefing.bid_site:
        trace.event("briefing", "bid_site_corrected", read=briefing.bid_site, contract=contract_site)
        briefing = briefing.model_copy(update={"bid_site": contract_site})
    trace.event("briefing", "done", **briefing.model_dump(exclude={"submission_steps"}))
    bid, mail = sessions[briefing.bid_site], sessions[briefing.mail_site]
    for session in (bid, mail):  # critical after all: warm until the margin before the deadline
        session.until = max(session.until or 0, deadline - browser_tools.START_MARGIN)
    # The bid form's steps that need no research (bidder data, offer type) run while the research does.
    flow = BidFlow(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline)
    flow.start()
    if answer is None and os.environ.get("AGENT_RESEARCH", "1") != "0":
        answer, attributes = await research(task, briefing, contexts, trace, deadline, sessions)
    # A start still running is waited for by the session's first look; one that gave up gets a fresh tab there.
    trace.event("starts", "state", **{name: ("up" if s.ok else "starting" if s.starting else "down")
                                      for name, s in sessions.items()}, pending=sum(not t.done() for t in starts.values()))
    try:
        result = await flow.finish(answer, attributes)
    except Exception as error:  # never end without trying to sign: one more pass with what is on screen
        trace.event("submit", "crashed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
        result = await submit_bid(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline, answer, attributes)
    trace.event("result", "done", result=result.model_dump() if result else None)
    return None


async def research(task: dict, briefing, contexts: list, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                   warm: dict[str, SiteSession] | None = None) -> tuple[dict | None, dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None]:
    """The orchestrator's answer and material attributes; (None, None) when it fails or builds nothing."""
    answer, attributes, problems = None, None, []
    orchestrator = None
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        orchestrator = Orchestrator(task, briefing, {s["siteId"]: c for s, c in zip(task["access"], contexts)},
                                    trace, deadline, warm=warm)
        problems = orchestrator.board.problems
        answer, _ = await orchestrator.run()
        attributes = orchestrator.attributes
    except Exception as error:  # the signed bid must never be lost to a research failure
        trace.event("orchestrator", "failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
    if answer is None and orchestrator is not None:  # still the reference, decision and any discount read
        answer = orchestrator.fallback_answer()
    trace.event("orchestrator", "done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), answer=answer,
                attributes=attributes, problems=problems[:30])
    path = Path(trace.path).with_name("answer.json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    print(f"Answer for the bid form written to {path}", flush=True)
    return answer, attributes


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright)  # more browsers: browsers.connect(playwright, 1), ...
        try:
            answer = await solve(task, page)
        finally:  # the platform keeps only the last lines of a run's output: repeat the phases there
            tracing.print_summary()
            print("===== model calls by caller =====\n" + llm.usage_table(), flush=True)
    if answer is None:
        print("No answer to submit through the API: the bid is entered on the website", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""
The agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

v2: read the brief, then the orchestrator (planner, findings board, research workers, verifier, calc) builds the
answer, and submit.py enters and signs the bid with it; without an answer every position is omitted, as in v1.
AGENT_RESEARCH=0 skips the research (the v1 path). See docs/plan.md.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import localenv  # noqa: F401  (first: local runs read agent/.env before any module reads its settings)
import browser_tools
import browsers
import llm
import loopwatch
import run as contract
from briefing import read_brief
from browser_tools import SiteSession
from orchestrator import Orchestrator
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from submit import BidFlow, Mailbox, submit_bid
import tracing
from tracing import Trace

SAFETY_SECONDS = 90  # the answer must be in before the run expires
LOCAL_SECONDS = 20 * 60  # the scouting run does not expire; behave like a scored run
RESEARCH_START_SECONDS = 600  # a website that only research needs is warmed this long, then given up


def warm_up(sessions: dict[str, SiteSession], deadline: float, critical: set[str]) -> dict[str, asyncio.Task]:
    """
    Start signing in to every website in the background and return at once: nothing waits for all of them. The
    `critical` ones (the bid website, the mailbox) keep retrying until START_MARGIN before the deadline; the others
    give up after RESEARCH_START_SECONDS. A session whose start is still running can be handed out: its first look
    waits for the start (SiteSession.revive).
    """
    browser_tools.DEADLINE = deadline
    tasks = {}
    for name, session in sessions.items():
        limit = deadline - browser_tools.START_MARGIN
        if name not in critical:
            limit = min(limit, time.monotonic() + RESEARCH_START_SECONDS)
        session.until = limit
        tasks[name] = asyncio.create_task(session.start(until=limit), name=f"start@{name}")
        tasks[name].add_done_callback(lambda t: t.cancelled() or t.exception())  # failures are traced in start
    return tasks


async def solve(task: dict, page, answer: dict | None = None,
                attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """
    Enter the bid on the run's website (a "site" submission) and return None.

    `answer` (calc's BidResult.answer()) and `attributes` (per position, the chosen material's attributes) are what
    the bid worker enters; positions they do not give completely are omitted. Unless given, the orchestrator
    researches them; a research failure never costs the signed bid.
    """
    trace = Trace()
    loopwatch.Watchdog(activity=lambda: trace.last).start()  # a blocked loop or a silent run dumps its stacks
    left = min(contract.seconds_left(task), LOCAL_SECONDS)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + left - SAFETY_SECONDS
    # Sign in to every website in the background: the brief, the planner and the workers never wait for all of
    # them. The bid website (named by the run contract) keeps warming; the mailbox too, once the brief names it.
    contexts = await browsers.more_contexts(page, len(task["access"]))
    sessions = {site["siteId"]: SiteSession(site, context, trace) for site, context in zip(task["access"], contexts)}
    contract_site = (task.get("submission") or {}).get("siteId")
    starts = warm_up(sessions, deadline, {contract_site} if contract_site in sessions else set(sessions))
    briefing = await read_brief(task)
    # The run contract names the submission website; it wins over the model's reading of the brief.
    if contract_site in sessions and contract_site != briefing.bid_site:
        trace.event("briefing", "bid_site_corrected", read=briefing.bid_site, contract=contract_site)
        briefing = briefing.model_copy(update={"bid_site": contract_site})
    trace.event("briefing", "done", **briefing.model_dump(exclude={"submission_steps"}))
    bid, mail = sessions[briefing.bid_site], sessions[briefing.mail_site]
    for session in (bid, mail):  # critical after all: warm until the margin before the deadline
        session.until = max(session.until or 0, deadline - browser_tools.START_MARGIN)
    # The bid form's steps that need no research (bidder data, offer type) run while the research does.
    flow = BidFlow(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline)
    flow.start()
    if answer is None and os.environ.get("AGENT_RESEARCH", "1") != "0":
        answer, attributes = await research(task, briefing, contexts, trace, deadline, sessions)
    # A start still running is waited for by the session's first look; one that gave up gets a fresh tab there.
    trace.event("starts", "state", **{name: ("up" if s.ok else "starting" if s.starting else "down")
                                      for name, s in sessions.items()}, pending=sum(not t.done() for t in starts.values()))
    try:
        result = await flow.finish(answer, attributes)
    except Exception as error:  # never end without trying to sign: one more pass with what is on screen
        trace.event("submit", "crashed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
        result = await submit_bid(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline, answer, attributes)
    trace.event("result", "done", result=result.model_dump() if result else None)
    return None


async def research(task: dict, briefing, contexts: list, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                   warm: dict[str, SiteSession] | None = None) -> tuple[dict | None, dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None]:
    """The orchestrator's answer and material attributes; (None, None) when it fails or builds nothing."""
    answer, attributes, problems = None, None, []
    orchestrator = None
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        orchestrator = Orchestrator(task, briefing, {s["siteId"]: c for s, c in zip(task["access"], contexts)},
                                    trace, deadline, warm=warm)
        problems = orchestrator.board.problems
        answer, _ = await orchestrator.run()
        attributes = orchestrator.attributes
    except Exception as error:  # the signed bid must never be lost to a research failure
        trace.event("orchestrator", "failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
    if answer is None and orchestrator is not None:  # still the reference, decision and any discount read
        answer = orchestrator.fallback_answer()
    trace.event("orchestrator", "done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), answer=answer,
                attributes=attributes, problems=problems[:30])
    path = Path(trace.path).with_name("answer.json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    print(f"Answer for the bid form written to {path}", flush=True)
    return answer, attributes


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright)  # more browsers: browsers.connect(playwright, 1), ...
        try:
            answer = await solve(task, page)
        finally:  # the platform keeps only the last lines of a run's output: repeat the phases there
            tracing.print_summary()
            print("===== model calls by caller =====\n" + llm.usage_table(), flush=True)
    if answer is None:
        print("No answer to submit through the API: the bid is entered on the website", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

from verify import VERIFY_SECONDS, confirm_decision, verify_board, wording_check

try:  # the pipeline degrades without them
    import research_tender
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    research_tender = None
try:
    import research_mail
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    research_mail = None

# research ends this long before the end: the form needs up to ~185 s and signing ~30 s (173 s with a bad TAN)
SUBMIT_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_SUBMIT_SECONDS", "390"))
FORM_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("AGENT_FORM_SECONDS", "300"))  # the bid form and signing need this much
# Mail tabs in the webmail's one browser: about nine record kinds took three rounds over four tabs, and the mail is the
# last research to finish; six tabs take them in two rounds (tabs are free, the work and its cost stay the same).
MAIL_TABS = int(os.environ.get("MAIL_TABS", "6"))
SPEC_STEPS_FAST = int(os.environ.get("SPEC_STEPS_FAST", "25"))  # navigation steps of the fast spec attempt
SPEC_STEPS_THINKING = int(os.environ.get("SPEC_STEPS_THINKING", "35"))  # and of the careful one, run alongside
SELECT_SECONDS = 75.0  # the final material choice (a model call per requirement, in parallel)
DEFERRED_SECONDS = 90.0  # reading deferred ERP hits before the final choice (rare: an amendment moved the match)
KIND_OPTIONS = set(inspect.signature(research_mail.research_kind).parameters) if research_mail else set()
KIND_MIN_SECONDS = 120.0  # a mail record kind's search budget: at least this
KIND_MAX_SECONDS = 240.0  # and at most this, from the mail time left per kind
MAIL_RETRY_SECONDS = 90.0  # mail time a kind's second try needs

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the planner

FACT_KINDS = {
    "tender": "the tender itself: its notice and documents with the positions (bill of quantities: quantities, "
              "units, requirement ids)",
    # its own kind: the bidder Q&A can live on another website than the tender (e.g. the buyer's portal)
    "qa": "the bidder questions and answers / clarifications of the tender (quantity changes, withdrawn answers, "
          "scoped technical amendments, and per-position keys for condition groups, packaging, delivery "
          "commitments, setup pools and bonus plans), on whichever website publishes them",
    "specification": "the buyer's technical specification: which revision is current and the technical "
                     "requirement (attributes, catalogue group, pieces per set) per requirement id",
    "materials": "the bidder's own ERP: the materials of a catalogue group with status, stock, lead times, "
                 "pieces per carton, masses, metal index code and price conditions with quantity scales",
    "mails": "authority records in the bidder's own mailbox: discount approval, condition rules, metal index "
             "rates, stroke reserves, packaging tariffs, delivery commitments, exchange rates, setup pools, "
             "bonus plans",
}


class Need(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal[tuple(FACT_KINDS)] = Field(description="Which facts")  # type: ignore[valid-type]
    site: str = Field(description="siteId of the website that holds them")
    why: str = Field(description="One sentence: which bid rules need these facts")


class Plan(BaseModel):
    needs: list[Need] = Field(description="Every kind of fact the bid needs (each kind at least once), each with "
                                          "its website")


def complete_plan(plan: Plan, briefing: Briefing, ids: set[str]) -> tuple[Plan, list[str]]:
    """
    A plan that still lacks a fact kind after the model's retries: the tender goes to the bid website and the mails
    to the mailbox (both read from the brief); a missing specification or ERP goes to every website that holds no
    other kind. Returns the completed plan and what was filled in.
    """
    have = {n.kind for n in plan.needs}
    free = sorted(ids - {n.site for n in plan.needs} - {briefing.bid_site, briefing.mail_site})
    needs, filled = list(plan.needs), []
    for kind in FACT_KINDS:
        if kind in have:
            continue
        for site in ([briefing.bid_site] if kind in ("tender", "qa") else [briefing.mail_site] if kind == "mails"
                     else free):
            if site in ids:
                needs.append(Need(kind=kind, site=site, why="missing from the model's plan; filled in"))
                filled.append(f"{kind}@{site}")
    return Plan(needs=needs), filled


async def plan_research(task: dict, briefing: Briefing) -> Plan:
    """
    One model call: from the brief, which facts the bid needs and which website each comes from. Every fact kind
    is needed (the rules use the tender, the specification, the ERP and the mails), so a plan that drops one is
    sent back; one still incomplete after the retries is asked once more without that check and completed by
    complete_plan().
    """
    ids = {s["siteId"] for s in task["access"]}
    sites = "\n".join(f"- siteId {s['siteId']}: {s['url']}" for s in task["access"])
    kinds = "\n".join(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in FACT_KINDS.items())
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=Plan, model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("plan", False)), retries=3,
                  instructions="You plan the research for a tender bid from its brief: which kinds of facts the "
                               "bid rules need, and on which of the run's websites each kind is found. Use the "
                               "siteIds exactly.")
    strict = [True]

    @agent.output_validator
    def _known(plan: Plan) -> Plan:
        bad = sorted({n.site for n in plan.needs} - ids)
        if bad:
            raise ModelRetry(f"{bad} are not siteIds of this run: {sorted(ids)}")
        missing = [k for k in FACT_KINDS if k not in {n.kind for n in plan.needs}]
        if missing and strict[0]:
            raise ModelRetry(f"The bid rules need every kind of fact; {missing} have no website yet. Add each "
                             f"with the website that holds it.")
        return plan

    brief = task["brief"]
    prompt = (f"Websites of this run:\n{sites}\n\nKinds of facts the workers can establish:\n{kinds}\n\n"
              f"The bid is entered on {briefing.bid_site}; the bidder's mailbox is {briefing.mail_site}.\n\n"
              f"Brief:\n{brief}")
    try:
        return (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"[plan] no complete plan ({type(error).__name__}): asked again, gaps filled in", flush=True)
    strict[0] = False
    try:
        plan = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception:
        plan = Plan(needs=[])
    plan, filled = complete_plan(plan, briefing, ids)
    print(f"[plan] filled in {filled}", flush=True)
    return plan
